columns.name: sku
columns.description: Addressing key; NOT NULL per PI2. Part of the (sku, location) unique pair (PI1).

columns.name: location
columns.description: Addressing key; NOT NULL per PI2. Part of the (sku, location) unique pair (PI1).

columns.name: inventory_code
columns.description: Stored inventory code; NOT NULL per PI2.

columns.name: quantity
columns.description: Stored stock level; NOT NULL per PI2 and CHECK (>= 0) per PI3.

columns.name: actor
columns.description: Actor who filed the adjustment (NFR-F1-1 audit).

columns.name: updated_at
columns.description: Last write timestamp, refreshed on upsert of an existing (sku, location) pair.

schema_changes.detail: Create stock_records with id (uuid PK, gen_random_uuid()), sku, location, inventory_code, quantity (all NOT NULL), actor, created_at, updated_at (timestamptz default now()). Add composite unique constraint on (sku, location) and CHECK (quantity >= 0).
schema_changes.migration_note: Additive create-only migration (PI5): downgrade drops the table cleanly; no existing table altered, so records predating F1 are preserved (NFR-F1-1/R1). The (sku, location) unique constraint lets the repository run the read-then-write upsert in one transaction (PI4).
